article.title: Ex utero mouse embryogenesis from pre-gastrulation to late organogenesis
reviewed_locators: Publisher workbook MOESM11, Panel d, culture-efficiency cells B33:E36
Publisher workbook MOESM12, Panel b, culture-efficiency cells B24:C24
Publisher workbook MOESM11, Panel e, individual length measurement cells B3:I45

stage_coverage.starting_state_limit: post-implantation mouse embryos; no pre-implantation-to-birth trajectory
stage_coverage.cohort_linkage: The E5.5, E6.5, and E7.5 starting-stage cohorts are separate protocols/cohorts and must not be joined into one continuous embryo trajectory.

reported_endpoint.timepoint: after four culture days, approximately E11
reported_endpoint.normal_development_summary: The article reports approximately 77% normal embryo development after four days across different mouse strains.
reported_endpoint.length_measurement_source_data: MOESM11 Panel e contains 216 numeric embryo-length cells across eight separately labeled in-utero and ex-utero groups. Group cell counts are 13, 32, 19, 15, 15, 43, 38, and 41. The workbook title gives the antero-posterior axis for E8.5 and crown-rump axis for E9.5 onward. Ex-utero +Day labels remain culture time and are not converted to gestational age; group-local 'Embryo 1' labels do not establish identity across columns. Derived group means, sample SDs and SEMs are in the Cycle268 summary CSV and are not source-printed values.
adverse_outcome_narrative: The authors report abnormalities, abrupt interruption of yolk-sac circulation, and pericardial effusion after four days, followed by rapid death overnight.

The authors interpret this as consistent with inadequate oxygen and nutrient supply relative to increased body size and the lack of maternal blood supply in the ex-utero system; this is an author interpretation, not an isolated causal test.
reported_endpoint.denominator_status: Publisher source workbook MOESM11 Panel d reports 126 normally developed embryos / 163 total at +Day 4 (77% printed); summing the 12 experiment rows with a Day 4 fraction reproduces 126/163. The Day 4 denominator is timepoint-specific and excludes experiments 4-6, which are marked not continued; it is not the 230-embryo Day 1 denominator or a verified all-start survival risk set. No embryo identifiers or unit-linked event sequence are reported. Do not call this a survival probability.

caption_accounting.figure_1d: n denotes total embryos and x denotes experiments; plotted values are mean ± s.e.m.
caption_accounting.extended_data_figure_2b: Parenthetical numbers denote embryos assessed per condition at each sampled timepoint; embryos dissected, fixed, or moved to other conditions are subtracted from the total.
caption_accounting.source_workbook_day4: MOESM11 Panel d reports culture efficiency as normally developed embryos / total at +Day 1 through +Day 4: 227/230, 212/230, 155/185 and 126/163. Its note defines dash rows as cultures not continued due to experimental requirements. The daily denominators must remain distinct.

reported_endpoint.functional_limit: Morphological normality at the sampled endpoint does not establish sustained survival, mature organ function, complete gestation, live birth, or postnatal health.

data_access_and_intake.data_availability_statement: The article states that source data are provided with the paper and lists publisher XLSX source-data files for Fig. 1 and Extended Data Fig. 2, among others.
data_access_and_intake.source_workbook_status: Two small XLSX files were retrieved directly from the DOI-derived official Springer static-content route and opened read-only. MOESM11 contains Panel d and Panel e; Panel d reports the E7.5 culture-efficiency series and says it is related to Fig. 1e and Extended Data Fig. 2b,c, while Panel e contains 216 individual length cells across eight groups. MOESM12 contains an E6.5 static-culture Panel b. Their contents are compatible with the Nature page's Source Data Fig. 1 and Extended Data Fig. 2 listings, but the exact page download-anchor-to-MOESM filename mapping was not verified because a normal article-page open still redirected to an inaccessible cookie authorization endpoint. No access-control workaround was attempted.
data_access_and_intake.figure_caption_access_screen: Nature article HTML/PDF and Source data link did not expose the Figure 1 measurement caption through the public web reader; the article-body route redirected to cookie handling, and the official figure image timed out. PubMed ESummary lists PMID, DOI and PII, without a PMCID in the articleids list. Do not infer caption-level n/statistics from this access screen.

geo_sequence_dataset.series_title: Ex utero Mouse Embryogenesis from Pre-Gastrulation to Late-Organogenesis

E8.5_ex_utero: GSM4498729 (source title: replicates 2 and 3 pooled; 3 embryos)
E8.5_in_utero_control: GSM4498733 (source title: replicates 2 and 3 pooled; 3 embryos)

geo_sequence_dataset.terminal_boundary_coverage: The 20 GEO sample records include E8.5 and E10.5 embryo labels plus stem-cell controls; none is labeled E11 or later.
geo_sequence_dataset.interpretation_limit: These are molecular-sample records, including pooled E8.5 libraries. They are not a starting-cohort survival denominator, do not locate onset of terminal deterioration, and expose no same-embryo join to Figure 1 development/survival outcomes. Sample labels and replicate numbers do not independently authenticate litter hierarchy or connect sequencing samples to the terminal risk set.
geo_sequence_dataset.retrieval_method: NCBI E-utilities GDS accession search and summary, retmax 100; all 20 GSM sample records inspected. Raw reads and count matrices were not downloaded or analyzed.

assay_type_mapping.geo_series_type: Expression profiling by high throughput sequencing
assay_type_mapping.sample_run_link: GEO sample GSM4498724 links to SRA experiment SRX8178759; GSM4498728 links to SRX8178763.
assay_type_mapping.bulk_vs_single_cell_status: The GEO/SRA metadata inspected here does not distinguish bulk from single-cell for the representative libraries or map GSM/SRX records to the paper's bulk versus single-cell figures. The article states that both data types are deposited under GSE149372; the sample-to-assay crosswalk remains unresolved.
assay_type_mapping.rate_limit_note: A later E-utilities request returned an API rate-limit response. No retry was made; only validated response files are listed below.

data_access_and_intake.observation_promotion: Candidate datasets record six source-reported aggregate culture-efficiency summaries with timepoint-specific denominator records, plus 216 MOESM11 Panel e length measurements with source cell locators. They remain candidate and are not promoted to a human-reviewed ledger.
data_access_and_intake.reason_not_promoted: The workbook records provide no persistent embryo identities or verified same-unit links across sampled days. Culture-efficiency tables lack complete all-start disposition accounting or a survival endpoint. Two E6.5 experiment-level percentage literals disagree with their printed numerator/denominator pairs; the aggregate counts still sum to the workbook totals. Length is a morphology endpoint. Human review and exact figure-download-anchor mapping remain pending.

feasibility_boundary.reported_achievement: Separate mouse embryo culture cohorts were reported from post-implantation stages through approximately E11, with the E7.5-start cohort reaching late organogenesis before reported terminal deterioration.
feasibility_boundary.design_relevance: The reported deterioration makes support across the growing extraembryonic exchange interface a distinct unresolved handoff after early organogenesis. The paper does not establish a tested repair or a transferable human specification.
feasibility_boundary.model_use: Mouse developmental milestone and terminal-failure evidence only; do not concatenate with separate fetal-support cohorts or convert stage to human gestational age.
